I will keep my farm simple and labor-efficient because I only have 7.5 mu, there are just two people in the household, and some labor is tied up off-farm. I will keep the main wheat-maize rotation on most of the land, because that fits my experience, my irrigation conditions, and the local climate. I will put 6.5 mu into winter wheat followed by summer maize on the same land, and I will reserve 1.0 mu for kohlrabi as a cash crop in the cooler season. I will use improved or hybrid seed where it gives me stable emergence and yield, and I will not push fertilizer to extremes. With well irrigation, I will water at the key stages instead of irrigating too often. I will also keep pesticide use moderate and only plan for the main pressure points, because I want to control cost, reduce unnecessary field passes, and keep management practical for my household.
